title: 第12章 发疯的陌生人

content_zh:
但她还是坚持上夜班，主要原因并非为了那份工资，甚至也不是为了不让约翰尼太难做，而是……
在第二场审讯室的戏里，乔治也有一定程度的忘词问题，搞得下戏以后已经是五点多了，珍妮卸妆换了衣服，由戴夫匆忙将她载到餐厅，已经迟到了两小时，但约翰尼并没责怪她什么，反而告诉她，两小时的迟到没什么问题，等人少了以后还可以早走，不过相应的也就是她的基本工资被削减成了一半。
珍妮对此没什么意见，她有些错估拍戏的疲累程度了，在演艺空间里，她是感觉不到肉体疲乏的。顶多只有连续入戏带来的精神疲倦，而今天虽然只拍了两场戏，但她没想到的是在等待期间也不能休息，为了保持礼服不皱，她甚至要比在餐厅服务还更累。
接下来又是六小时的轮班，到最后珍妮几乎是用意志力在支持，等到夜宵最繁忙的时段一过，她立刻和约翰尼打招呼下了班。
戴夫一直在餐厅里等她，不管她怎么坚持都不肯走，他没让珍妮步行回家，而是开车送她到楼底下。
珍妮累得在车上就睡着了，车一停就惊醒过来：“到了？”
“到了。”戴夫说，温和地看着她，“上去休息吧，明天你还得早起——我来接你一起吃早饭。”
这就是珍妮需要上夜班的原因，如果没有夜班，戴夫会带她去吃晚饭，然后一切就会顺其自然，她没有什么办法能在不伤害到戴夫的情况下阻止他告白，而她也不想现在就拒绝戴夫。
如果这是利用，她也能坦然承认。一个一无所有的女孩想要在好莱坞上位，怎么可能不做点亏心事？珍妮还算是在坚持自己的底线，她不想陪戴夫睡，不但因为她对出卖自己的肉体没有爱好，也因为这对于戴夫的品行来说是种侮辱——如果他是那种色迷迷的制作人，明显瞄准了她的美色，她倒不介意若即若离地吊着他，给自己汲取了足够好处以后再把他一脚踹掉，也不会有任何心理负担。就因为戴夫对她是如此真诚，她才会一直回避图穷匕见的时刻，这不但是因为她需要戴夫这个朋友，也实在因为她并不情愿去伤害她。
能让她良心稍安的是她实际上还是很喜欢戴夫的——在她前夫以后，陈贞对于高富帅已经毫无迷恋了，想当年她前夫出现在电影学院时，也是身家亿万、潇洒帅气、温柔体贴的完美男人，后来事实证明，一个人的本质和他是否高富帅，实在没有太大关系。戴夫工作敬业，为人真诚，羞怯的个性之后是有些笨拙的幽默，如果不是因为她的情况如此特殊，她真的不介意和他继续往下发展。
但现在她没有这个时间，陈贞真的没这个时间，对于目标是好莱坞巅峰的女孩来说，和戴夫的关系会是极大的浪费。
珍妮此时睡眼惺忪，没有多余的精力内疚，她谢过戴夫，然后步履蹒跚地爬上四楼，进门以后没有洗澡就倒在床上睡了过去。
第二天早上，戴夫真的来接她一起去吃早饭，坐在早餐店里，闻着可口的糖油香味，看到客人的牙齿幸福地陷进甜甜圈里，还有培根配煎蛋那油汪汪、咸滋滋的味道，珍妮的胃部简直是烧灼地疼痛起来。一想到在她跟前还是长达十多小时的拍摄，以及晚上的六小时轮班，她真的有种强烈而饥渴的欲望，想要吃上哪怕一口高糖高盐的蛋糕，不论味道多平庸，就只是要品尝那种幸福的甜味和淀粉的芬芳——
“黑咖啡，一份鸡肉沙拉，不要酱，”她最终还是只点了她的老搭配，只是在犹豫之后加了一句，“给我加半份油醋汁，谢谢。”
戴夫要了培根配煎蛋、巧克力松饼和摩卡咖啡、橙汁。珍妮瞪着他的早饭，真的、真的开始明白为什么大明星的脾气通常不好。
但她不能多吃，因为拍戏和上班的关系，她昨天压根也没锻炼，这对于肌肉来说已经是个损失，如果再吃下热量超标食物，那简直就是一场灾难。

content_en:
But she still insists on working the night shift. The main reason is not for the salary, or even to not make it too difficult for Johnny, but...
In the second interrogation room scene, George also had a problem with forgetting his words. It was already after five o'clock after the scene ended. Jenny took off her makeup and changed clothes, and Dave hurriedly drove her to the restaurant. She was already two hours late, but Johnny did not blame her. Instead, he told her that being two hours late was no problem and that she could leave early when there were fewer people. However, accordingly, her basic salary was cut in half.
Jenny had no objection to this. She had misjudged the level of fatigue from filming. In the performing arts space, she could not feel physical fatigue. At most, she was just mentally tired from being in the movie continuously. Although she only filmed two scenes today, what she didn't expect was that she wouldn't be able to rest while waiting. In order to keep the dress wrinkle-free, she was even more tired than serving in a restaurant.
Another six-hour shift followed, and in the end Jenny was almost using willpower to support her. As soon as the busiest period of the night snack was over, she immediately greeted Johnny and got off work.
Dave had been waiting for her in the restaurant and refused to leave no matter how hard she insisted. Instead of letting Jenny walk home, he drove her downstairs.
Jenny was so tired that she fell asleep in the car, and woke up as soon as the car stopped: "Are we here?"
"Here we are." Dave said, looking at her gently, "Go up and rest. You have to get up early tomorrow - I'll pick you up and have breakfast with you."
This is why Jenny needs to work the night shift. If there is no night shift, Dave will take her to dinner and everything will flow naturally. There is nothing she can do to stop Dave from confessing without hurting him, and she doesn't want to reject Dave now.
If this was taking advantage of, she could admit it frankly. How could a girl with nothing want to be in Hollywood without doing something wrong? Jenny was still sticking to her bottom line. She didn't want to sleep with Dave, not only because she had no interest in selling her body, but also because it was an insult to Dave's character - if he was the kind of lustful producer who was obviously targeting her beauty, she wouldn't mind hanging him from a distance, and she wouldn't have any psychological burden if she kicked him off after getting enough benefits for herself. Just because Dave was so sincere to her, she always avoided the moments of incest, not only because she needed Dave as a friend, but also because she was unwilling to hurt her.
What reassured her conscience was that she actually liked Dave very much. After her ex-husband, Chen Zhen was no longer obsessed with tall, rich and handsome people. She remembered that when her ex-husband showed up at the film school, he was also a perfect man with a net worth of hundreds of millions, handsome, gentle and considerate. Later, it turned out that a person's nature has nothing to do with whether he is tall, rich and handsome. Dave was dedicated and sincere, with a shy personality that was punctuated by a somewhat awkward sense of humor, and if it weren't for the fact that her situation was so unique, she really wouldn't mind moving on with him.
But now she doesn't have the time, and Chen Zhen really doesn't have the time. For a girl who aims to be at the top of Hollywood, a relationship with Dave would be a huge waste.
Jenny was bleary-eyed at this time and had no extra energy to feel guilty. She thanked Dave, then staggered up to the fourth floor. After entering the door, she fell on the bed without taking a shower and fell asleep.
The next morning, Dave actually came to pick her up to have breakfast with her. Sitting in the breakfast bar, smelling the delicious aroma of sugar and oil, seeing the customer's teeth sinking happily into the donuts, and the greasy, salty smell of bacon and fried eggs, Jenny's stomach was literally burning with pain. When she thought about the more than ten hours of filming in front of her and the six-hour shift at night, she really had a strong and hungry desire to eat even a bite of high-sugar and high-salt food.The cake, no matter how mediocre it tastes, just wants to taste the sweetness of happiness and the fragrance of starch——
"Black coffee, a chicken salad, no sauce," she finally ordered her usual mix, adding only after some hesitation, "Half the vinaigrette, please."
Dave ordered bacon with fried eggs, chocolate chip waffles, mocha coffee, and orange juice. Jenny stared at his breakfast, really, really starting to understand why big stars usually had bad tempers.
But she couldn't eat more. Because of filming and work, she didn't exercise at all yesterday. This was already a loss for her muscles. If she ate more food with excess calories, it would be a disaster.
